items.information: Welcome to the second WCA competition in Kenya! More information under the respective tabs. New participants should bring some form of identification in order to confirm the information given during the registration. A passport is a good example since it shows name, age, nationality and so on. You only need to be present at the venue during the events in which you plan to attend. However, you need to be present at the venue no later than 15 minutes before your first event starts so that you have enough time to complete the registration. A few days before the competition, you will receive a participant email where we will address various important information for participants to know.

items.name: Hike 2 Cube Kenya 2023
items.information: Welcome! This will be the world's first ever WCA competition on top of a mountain! Please go through each and every tab for all the information about this trip, and let the organiser know about any specific quiries you may have. We will be hiking to the top of Ol Donyo Sabuk (Mt Kilimambogo). It is going to be a 9 kilometer walk to the top, and another 9 to come back down... This competition is recommended for only competitors aged 12 and above. Those who are aged younger may have difficulties walking long distances. It will be a road trip from the capital, Nairobi, to the venue in Machakos, and back. Competitors also have the option to drive up the mountain (provided they have their own personal vehicles) incase they are not in a position to hike. Make sure to inform the organiser in advance if this will be the case.

items.name: Gigiri Cubing Open AM 2025
items.information: **NOTE: THIS EVENT IS A SERIES COMPETITION.** **Each participant can only compete in one of the two competitions.** Gigiri Cubing Open AM 2025, and Gigiri Cubing Open PM 2025 are recognized as WCA series competitions. WCA series competitions are a series of multiple competitions. You can participate in only one of them. If you register for more than one competition in a series, only the earliest registration will be considered valid. The payment of 800ksh will be collected on the day of the competition at the registration desk. MPESA will also be accepted. This page is for Gigiri Cubing Open AM 2025. [Gigiri Cubing Open AM 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GigiriCubingOpenAM2025) (AM - Morning Session) - (From 8:30am to 12:30pm) [Gigiri Cubing Open PM 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/GigiriCubingOpenPM2025) (PM - Afternoon Session) - (From 1:30pm to 5:30pm) The registration timings for each event are as follows: AM : Begins at 8:30am. Closes at 9:00am PM : Begins at 1:30pm. Closes at 2:00pm The New Competitor's tutorial will be held at 8:45 for AM, and 13:45 for PM. If this is your first competition, do be on time for the competitor's tutorial. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. Photos and videos are taken in the venue. Please be familiar with the WCA Regulations, found here: https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/

items.information: # Welcome! This will be the second National Championship in Kenya! # **VOLUNTEERING** Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the New Competitor Tutorial. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind **ONLY VEGETERIAN FOOD WILL BE ALLOWED IN THE VENUE** No matter where you are, you can’t miss it. All competitors, including foreign participants, may compete and advance to the final rounds. However, **awards will be reserved exclusively for competitors of Kenyan nationality.** ## ## **NOTICE OF FILMING AND PHOTOGRAPHY** Photos and videos will be taken at this event, which may be used by [Cubing Kenya](https://www.instagram.com/cubing.kenya/reels/) for promotion, documentation, and dissemination of our activities

items.name: Nakuru Speedcubing Camp 2025
items.information: We are excited to introduce Kenya’s very first speedcubing camp! This will be a series of fun and helpful events where you can learn how to solve the cube faster and improve your skills. We will be gathering every holiday to practice, compete, and enjoy together. Everyone is welcome whether you are a beginner or an experienced cuber. Come join us and be part of this exciting new journey! We look forward to seeing you there..!
